author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the RAM cartel possibly showing it's face once again in a lawsuit that could decide if we can afford our systems in the future. RAM and many components are priced out of many peoples reach and instead of just looking at the AI companies, we have to look at the people making these products. Why? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
